phrases-57-13-14-shut-gate-borrow-from-y.title: 'Wait for Us, Let Us Take From Your Light' Outside the Shut Door
phrases-57-13-14-shut-gate-borrow-from-y.note: In Surah 57:13–14, hypocrites say to believers 'Wait for us, let us take from your light,' are told to turn back and search for light, and are shut outside a gated wall, matching the Foolish Virgins in Matthew 25:7–12.

discussion.view: Classical exegetes explain this scene as an eschatological event on the bridge (al-ṣirāṭ) where hypocrites lose their light and are separated from believers by a gated wall.
discussion.reply: Surah 57:13–14 reproduces the three sequential beats of Jesus' Parable of the Ten Virgins in Matthew 25:7–12: the plea to share light ('Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out'), the dismissal to go obtain it elsewhere ('go instead to the dealers and buy some for yourselves'), and the shutting of the door between the two groups.

phrases-57-13-14-shut-gate-borrow-from-y.quranEn: [13] On the Day when the hypocrite men and the hypocrite women will say to those who believed: ‘Wait for us! Let us borrow your light!’ It will be said, ‘Turn back and search for a light!’ And a wall with a door will be set up between them: on the inside of it (there is) mercy, and on the outside of it – facing (it) – (there is) the punishment. [14] They will call out to them: ‘Were we not with you?’ They will say, ‘Yes, indeed! But you tempted yourselves, and you waited and doubted, and wishful thinking deceived you, until the command of God came, and the Deceiver deceived you about God.

sources.title: Gospel of Matthew
sources.en: "The foolish said to the prudent, 'Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.' "But the prudent answered, 'No, there will not be enough for us and you [too]; go instead to the dealers and buy [some] for yourselves.' "And while they were going away to make the purchase, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast; and the door was shut. "Later the other virgins also came, saying, 'Lord, lord, open up for us.' "But he answered, 'Truly I say to you, I do not know you.
